typed_functionals.source: Circ_perp(O,r)=total source Euclidean arc measure around C_perp(O,r)
typed_functionals.target: Circ_E(r)=T_r, the minimal number of legal canonical Enterprise turns required to close the AL orbit

proof: R_BRC,r collapses each connected source arc fiber F_k to one target turn e_k.
At r=3 the source measures mu_perp(F_0) and mu_perp(F_1) are unequal while both target turns have native weight 1.
Therefore no target-local common source arc unit lambda(3) makes the collapse edgewise isometric.
Consequently compatibility/surjectivity/cyclic order do not imply equality between source total arc functional and target turn-period functional under a fixed local unit normalization.
conditional_isometry_statement: If an extra axiom required every target elementary turn at radius r to carry one common source arc unit lambda(r), then source circumference would equal lambda(r)*T_r; if the unit normalization were also fixed compatibly with diameter, the source and target circumference/diameter constants would be forced to coincide. This is an additional isometry axiom, not a BRC theorem, and r=3 refutes its equal-fiber premise.
target_constant_preserved: kappa_E remains defined natively by lim T_r/(2r), with kappa_E^2=12 and kappa_E>0
